title: Shopping
description: Buy things, ask the price, and push back on it.

questions.sentence: Eha kete taka?
questions.correctAnswer: Eha pachasa taka.
questions.translatedSentence: This is fifty rupees.

questions.sentence: Ehara dama bahut besi.
questions.correctAnswer: Its price is too high.

questions.sentence: Apana kana kinibe?
questions.correctAnswer: Mu kadali kinibi.
questions.translatedSentence: I will buy bananas.

questions.sentence: Mote gote jhola darkar.
options: I want to buy a shirt.
questions.correctAnswer: I need a bag.

questions.sentence: Kadali kilo ku kete?
questions.correctAnswer: Chalisa taka kilo.
questions.translatedSentence: Forty rupees a kilo.

questions.sentence: Ei dokan bahut bada.
questions.correctAnswer: This shop is very big.

questions.sentence: Apana kouthi jauchanti?
questions.correctAnswer: Mu bazar jauchi.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going to the market.

questions.sentence: Eha bahut sasta.
questions.correctAnswer: This is very cheap.

questions.sentence: Piaja kete taka kilo?
questions.correctAnswer: Kudi taka kilo.
questions.translatedSentence: Twenty rupees a kilo.

questions.sentence: Apananka pakhare chhena poda achi ki?
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, taja chhena poda achi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we have fresh chhena poda.

questions.sentence: Mote dui kilo aloo deantu.
options: Please give me two kilos of potatoes.
Please give me two kilos of onions.
questions.correctAnswer: Please give me two kilos of potatoes.

questions.sentence: Aau kichhi darkar achi ki?
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, tike luna deantu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please give me a little salt.

questions.sentence: Chaula kouthi miliba?
questions.correctAnswer: Where can I get rice?

questions.sentence: Ehi ranga apananku pasanda ki?
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ehi nila ranga bhala.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, this blue colour is nice.

questions.sentence: Ehi dokanre taja machha miluchi.
options: Fresh fish is available in this shop.
Fresh fish is expensive in this shop.
Fresh vegetables are sold in this market.
questions.correctAnswer: Fresh fish is available in this shop.

questions.sentence: Mote gote nua sadhi dekhantu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, apana ehi sadhi dekhantu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please look at this saree.

questions.sentence: Mo pakhare eteki paisa nahin.
options: I do not have that much money.
I do not have a bag with me.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not have that much money.

questions.sentence: Apana kete kilo nebe?
questions.correctAnswer: Mu adha kilo nebi.
questions.translatedSentence: I will take half a kilo.

questions.sentence: Ehi sadhira dama tini sa taka.
options: Eha bahut mahanga, tike kama karantu.
questions.correctAnswer: Eha bahut mahanga, tike kama karantu.
questions.translatedSentence: That is too expensive, please bring it down a little.

questions.sentence: Dama tike kama karantu, mu ebe hin nebi.
options: Lower the price a little and I will take it right now.
Lower the price a little and I will come tomorrow.
The price is fine, so I will take it right now.
questions.correctAnswer: Lower the price a little and I will take it right now.

questions.sentence: Apana kete debe?
questions.correctAnswer: Mu dui sa taka debi.
questions.translatedSentence: I will give two hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Eha mo pain bahut mahanga heuchi.
options: This is working out too expensive for me.
This is quite cheap for me.
This shop is too far for me.
questions.correctAnswer: This is working out too expensive for me.

questions.sentence: Mu dui sa pachasa taka debi, chaliba?
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, niantu, apana pain eteki.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, take it, that much for you.

questions.sentence: Sesa dama kete, kahantu.
options: Say how many kilos you want.
questions.correctAnswer: Tell me the final price.

questions.sentence: Eteki dama re mu nebi nahin.
options: Ha, mu au dui kilo debi.
questions.correctAnswer: Tebe apana kete debe, kahantu.
questions.translatedSentence: Then tell me how much you will pay.

questions.sentence: Aau gote dokanre eha sasta miluchi.
options: This is cheaper in another shop.
This is not available in another shop.
questions.correctAnswer: This is cheaper in another shop.

questions.sentence: Kama dama re dele mu tinita nebi.
options: Thik achi, tinita pain sa taka.
questions.correctAnswer: Thik achi, tinita pain sa taka.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, one hundred rupees for three.

questions.sentence: Ehi shirt apananku thik hela ki?
options: Nahin, eha mo pain sana heuchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, eha mo pain sana heuchi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, this is too small for me.

questions.sentence: Mote au bada size dekhantu.
options: Please show me a bigger size.
Please show me a smaller size.
questions.correctAnswer: Please show me a bigger size.

questions.sentence: Apana kete piaja nebe?
questions.correctAnswer: Mote pancha kilo piaja darkar.
questions.translatedSentence: I need five kilos of onions.

questions.sentence: Ehi jhola bahut bhari heigala.
options: This bag has become very heavy.
This bag has become very dirty.
questions.correctAnswer: This bag has become very heavy.

questions.sentence: Adha kilo chhena poda hele chaliba?
options: Nahin, mu dui sa taka debi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, adha kilo hin deantu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please give just half a kilo.

questions.sentence: Ei sadhi lamba, kintu ranga bhala nahin.
options: This saree is long, but the colour is not nice.
This saree is long and the colour is nice.
This saree is short, but the colour is nice.
questions.correctAnswer: This saree is long, but the colour is not nice.

questions.sentence: Ehi juta apananka pain sana ki bada?
options: Eha tike bada heuchi, sana deantu.
Eha bahut sasta, mu tinita nebi.
questions.correctAnswer: Eha tike bada heuchi, sana deantu.
questions.translatedSentence: It is a bit big, please give me a smaller one.

questions.sentence: Gote kilo amba kete taka padiba?
options: How much will one kilo of mangoes cost?
How much will one kilo of bananas cost?
How many mangoes will one kilo be?
questions.correctAnswer: How much will one kilo of mangoes cost?

questions.sentence: Kete gota kadali nebe?
options: Kadali bahut mahanga, mu nebi nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Bara gota kadali deantu.
questions.translatedSentence: Please give me twelve bananas.

questions.sentence: Sabu misi kete hela?
options: Sabu misi chari sa taka hela.
questions.correctAnswer: Sabu misi chari sa taka hela.
questions.translatedSentence: Altogether it comes to four hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Mo pakhare khuchura nahin, sa taka notu achi.
options: I have no change, I only have a hundred rupee note.
I have no money, so I cannot buy this.
I have change, so take a hundred rupees.
questions.correctAnswer: I have no change, I only have a hundred rupee note.

questions.sentence: Apana kipari paisa debe?
options: Mu phone pe re paisa debi.
questions.correctAnswer: Mu phone pe re paisa debi.
questions.translatedSentence: I will pay by phone.

questions.sentence: Dayakari mote bill deantu.
options: Please give me one more bag.
questions.correctAnswer: Please give me the bill.

questions.sentence: Ehi jhola pain paisa lagiba ki?
options: Ha, jhola pain das taka lagiba.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, jhola pain das taka lagiba.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, the bag costs ten rupees.

questions.sentence: Mu ghara ru jhola anithili, tenu darkar nahin.
options: I brought a bag from home, so I do not need one.
I forgot my bag at home, so I need one.
I will bring a bag from home tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: I brought a bag from home, so I do not need one.

questions.sentence: Apananka khuchura pherai deuchi, ganti niantu.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhanyabad, thik achi.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, that is fine.

questions.sentence: Jadi khuchura nahin, tebe mu card re debi.
options: If there is no change, then I will pay by card.
If there is no change, then I will come tomorrow.
If the card does not work, then I will pay cash.
questions.correctAnswer: If there is no change, then I will pay by card.

questions.sentence: Card machine kaam karuchi ki?
options: Nahin, ebe network nahin, nagadare deantu.
Ha, mu dui kilo piaja nebi.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, ebe network nahin, nagadare deantu.
questions.translatedSentence: No, there is no network right now, please pay in cash.

questions.sentence: Kali mu ehi shirt kinithili, kintu size thik nahin.
options: Rasid achi ki, tahele mu badali kari debi.
Ha, mote dui kilo aloo deantu.
Nahin, ehi dokan kali bandha thila.
questions.correctAnswer: Rasid achi ki, tahele mu badali kari debi.
questions.translatedSentence: Do you have the receipt? Then I will exchange it.

questions.sentence: Ehi jhola dui dina re hin phatigala.
options: This bag tore within just two days.
This bag became heavy within two days.
I bought this bag just two days ago.
questions.correctAnswer: This bag tore within just two days.

questions.sentence: Apana paisa pherai debe ki badali debe?
options: Mu paisa pherai debi nahin, kintu badali kari debi.
Mu apananku au gote sadhi bikri karibi nahin.
Ha, mu kali dokan bandha karibi.
questions.correctAnswer: Mu paisa pherai debi nahin, kintu badali kari debi.
questions.translatedSentence: I will not refund the money, but I will exchange it.

questions.sentence: Ehi machha taja nuhen, tenu mu nebi nahin.
options: This fish is not fresh, so I will not take it.
This fish is fresh, so I will take it.
This fish is expensive, so I will not take it.
questions.correctAnswer: This fish is not fresh, so I will not take it.

questions.sentence: Rupa kama Bhubaneswar re sasta ki Cuttack re?
options: Cuttack re sasta mile, kahinki ki sethi hin taiari huae.
Bhubaneswar re machha bahut taja miluchi.
Mu Puri re Jagannath mandira dekhithili.
questions.correctAnswer: Cuttack re sasta mile, kahinki ki sethi hin taiari huae.
questions.translatedSentence: It is cheaper in Cuttack, because that is where it is made.

questions.sentence: Jadi rasid nathiba, tebe ame badali kari paribu nahin.
options: If there is no receipt, then we cannot exchange it.
If there is no receipt, then we will return the money.
If you have the receipt, then we can exchange it.
questions.correctAnswer: If there is no receipt, then we cannot exchange it.

questions.sentence: Mu ehi sadhi pheraibaku chahunchi, kahinki ki ranga uthigala.
options: Kshama karantu, ame dhua hoithiba jinisa pherai neu nahun.
Ha, apana au dui kilo piaja niantu.
Nahin, ehi sadhi Puri ru asichi.
questions.correctAnswer: Kshama karantu, ame dhua hoithiba jinisa pherai neu nahun.
questions.translatedSentence: Sorry, we do not take back items that have been washed.

questions.sentence: Ame ehi jinisa sata dina bhitare badali kari debu.
options: We will exchange this item within seven days.
We will refund this item within seven days.
We sold this item seven days ago.
questions.correctAnswer: We will exchange this item within seven days.

questions.sentence: Apana ehi dokan ku aau asibe ki?
options: Ha, asibi, kahinki ki ehathi jinisa bhala aau dama kama.
Nahin, mu ehathi kichhi kinithili nahin.
Ha, mu kali auto re Puri jibi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, asibi, kahinki ki ehathi jinisa bhala aau dama kama.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will come, because the goods here are good and the prices are low.
